decisions.reason: As a publicly announced flagship product line with several models, close to the core offer and central to the firm's digital-practice direction, the firm has invested and committed too visibly to abandon it one year after launch.

The continuing education institute builds on the firm's training resources and customer relationships, costs little to sustain, and its early results can still be attributed to ramp-up, so management will persist with it.
The remote screen-sharing support tool is a low-cost complement to the firm's support business that strengthens its connected-practice positioning, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
